name: teaching-told-1
label: Bryn hears Ash: the words ground in Bryn's own landmarks (rock, windmill)

name: teaching-told-2
label: Thirst runs to water and on to the told spring; Ash, the source, is on the mind

name: teaching-told-3
label: Water seen where it was told: the tentative place is moved onto the real spring

name: teaching-dry-1
label: The spring is dry: an expected thing missing, and a dry hollow where water should be

name: teaching-dry-2
label: Surprise and loss; the told water and its place fill the workspace

name: teaching-dry-3
label: Ash, having seen it dry, warns Bryn: the episode is judged a mistake

name: teaching-note-1
label: Ash writes the claim on a note: Bryn reads it; the note has it, the fact is held less

name: teaching-note-2
label: Days later, Bryn sees its lost note: the note's node lights, and the fact with it

name: teaching-note-3
label: Picked up and reread: the faded fact and source come back

name: teaching-chain-1
label: Cai hears Bryn, who says Ash said: two source links, one to Bryn and one to Ash
